header: The photo table (public.employee_photo, sql/19): which pictures an employee has and which version is current. Whoever may change the employee may change a photo (the kit's `begin`: HOD or a delegate); every change is a line in the employee manager's history ("photo", changed or removed), and that line never holds the picture.
